main_text.l: Oritur inde, vt naturalia mixta clande-
stinam quodammodo sentiant pugnam,
& in ipsis caca quadam vulnera, inquit
Lucretius, continuò infligantur. Nam
minimæ substantiæ, siue atomi accidenti-
bus referte contrariis opponuntur, agunt,
reagunt, luctantur, donec se se ab inui-
cem expediant, ac soluant. Ex quo in-
telligis, cur aliqua corpora, etiamsi ab
externa læsione remoueris, attamen pa-
tiantur, & aliquando tandem intereant,
quia videlicet hostis militat intus, dum
conatus quidam, & rixa fit à contrarijs in-
uicem se lancinantibus. Idcirco non omni
no iuuat si aromata pyxidibus vitreis con-
cludantur, nam paulatim sibi faciunt ca-
riem, se rodunt, ac terunt. Neque po-
mum, aut florem diu tuebere illæsum,
quamuis ab externo contrario serues, eo
quòd in se suæ necis radicem habet. Sic
omnino vniones alterantur ab intrinse-
co, cuadunt fuscæ, callum obducunt.
Ebur antiquum dehiscit, per venulas fit
rubrum, & fragilius. Calami auium se
comaculant, conterunt, vermes gene-
rant &c. vnde patere cuique potest, in
omni mixto suæ adesse principium alte-
rationis, quæ in sola contrariorum pu-
gna, & infensibili motu fita esse vide-
tur.
Hisce accedunt agentia extrinseca,
quæ per actiones in mixta exercitas iu-
uant in ijsdem alterationes, mouent
atomos, & minima corpora, vrgent,
pellunt, congregant, disgregant; v.gr.
ignis

page.notes: Marginal notes in the original (small letters at left and right edges) are not legible on the scan and are omitted. Some words near the left margin are damaged; readings such as "scotes" were not confidently determined. The bottom-right "ignis" is treated as a catchword-like line of text. Faint watermark-like text at lower right is a digitiser's mark and is omitted.
